  • Method Details

    • instancesByStatus

      @GET @Path("/instances/{status}") public List<Map<String,Object>> instancesByStatus(@PathParam("status") String status)
      The workflow instances currently in a given state, with the TaskId from each one's shared context. dratstats.py needs exactly this to decide whether a PGE is still running, and used to get it by calling workflowmgr.getWorkflowInstancesByStatus over XML-RPC. mnemosyne#95 removed XML-RPC, which left the statistics step with no way to ask the question at all, so the statistics core was never populated and every chart on the Proteus dashboard stayed empty.
